image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a golden-brown bagel topped with everything seasoning (sesame seeds, poppy seeds, dried garlic/onion). The bagel sits on white paper lining inside a dark container. A portion of a second bagel is visible on the left edge. The lighting highlights the glossy crust and the texture of the toppings.
